title: Screen-flow resume with a non-string value for a text screen field passes the resume gate, fails the downstream write and consumes the run
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · automation.screen-flow-roundtrip · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), beside #29133. Reproduced on 2 fresh runs.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_bulk_reassign/TASK_ID {}` → 200, run R paused.
2. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_reassign_wizard/runs/R/resume {"inputs":{"new_assignee":{"x":1}}}` → 400 FLOW_FAILED "Node 'apply' failed: update_record(showcase_task) failed: Assignee has an invalid text value: expected a string, received an object".
3. `GET runs/R` → status `failed`. A valid resume now answers 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND.

A number (`42`) passes the gate the same way. A missing value, by contrast, is refused 400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT and the run stays paused.

## Mechanism

`SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.ts`, line 73) holds value domains for `number`, `currency`, `percent` and `file` only; its doc comment says every other field type is a widget hint that constrains nothing, by design. So the gate admits an object for a `text` field, and the record validator (tightened by #29133) refuses it after the suspension has been spent.

The defect is the lost run: a caller-fixable value consumes a paused flow. Whether the fix is a `text` value domain at the gate or keeping the run resumable when the downstream write refuses is the lane's call; the closed-set design comment is the governing text to read first.

Owning package: `@objectstack/service-automation`. Full evidence: #31486, slice C3a.
